rows.text: returns 0 when `edx` is not below (unsigned) dword `rcx+0x18` with bit 31 cleared; otherwise returns qword `+0` of the 0x10-stride entry `edx`, on the base qword `rcx+0x20` when that count is above 1 and on `rcx+0x20` itself when it is 1

returns 0 when `edx` is not below (unsigned) dword `rcx+0x30` with bit 31 cleared; otherwise returns qword `+8` of the 0x40-stride entry `edx`, on the base qword `rcx+0x38` when that count is above 1 and on `rcx+0x38` itself when it is 1

returns 0 when `edx` is not below (unsigned) dword `rcx+0x20` with bit 31 cleared or when bit 0 of byte `rcx+0x74` is clear; otherwise returns qword `+8` of the 0x48-stride entry `edx`, on the base qword `rcx+0x28` when that count is above 1 and on `rcx+0x28` itself when it is 1

returns 0 when `edx` is not below (unsigned) dword `rcx+0x18` with bit 31 cleared or when bit 0 of byte `rcx+0x6C` is clear; otherwise returns qword `+8` of the 0x48-stride entry `edx`, on the base qword `rcx+0x20` when that count is above 1 and on `rcx+0x20` itself when it is 1

notes: All four: the count is re-read and re-masked after the bound check; the small-count arm also has a cmove to a null base for count 0, which the earlier edx < count check makes unreachable, so the sentence states only the count-1 case.
